tokens.name: bg-000
tokens.usage: Page ground. Off-black in dark, cool near-white in light. Scanline texture sits on this layer only.

tokens.name: bg-100
tokens.usage: HUD panel fill (dashboard tiles, cards, code blocks).

tokens.name: bg-200
tokens.usage: Hover and selected panel fill, inline code, table header rows.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: panel dividers, schematic grid lines, rules under section indices. Decorative only, never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Corner brackets, input and button borders, focus-adjacent outlines. 3:1 on bg-000 and bg-100 in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings on bg-000, bg-100, bg-200.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: post excerpts, project summaries, captions.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Data readouts and meta (coordinates, dates, uptime, build status). Passes 4.5:1 on every bg in both themes; the quietest text allowed.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Acid lime FILL: primary button, active nav marker, status dot, highlighter behind a word, selection. Always paired with on-accent text. In light theme never use as text or a thin line on white (fails contrast); use accent-text.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed on an accent fill (16:1).

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Lime as TEXT or stroke: section indices (01 /), active nav label, the blinking cursor, emphasised readouts. Deepened in light theme to keep 5:1.

tokens.name: cyan
tokens.usage: Muted cyan secondary: inline links, secondary tags (tech stack chips), blog category marks. Never for primary actions.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Status only: WIP tag, degraded readout. Small, never a block.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Status only: errors, offline readout. Small, never a block.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The name in nav and footer. Always uppercase, tracked out.

styles.name: display
styles.sample: Backend, by way of the Marines.
styles.usage: Homepage hero line and project titles on detail pages. One per page.

styles.name: h2
styles.sample: How the agent picks a bar
styles.usage: Section heads inside posts and project write-ups.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Panel titles in the dashboard grid, card titles.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: I spent four years running network infrastructure in Okinawa before I wrote my first Django view.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: AI date-night planner for NYC. FastAPI, Postgres, agents.
styles.usage: Panel and card summaries, experience entries.

styles.name: index
styles.usage: Section indices and nav items. Uppercase. Number in accent-text, label in ink.

styles.name: readout
styles.usage: Data readouts and meta in ink-faint: dates, coordinates, commit hashes, status.

styles.name: tag
styles.usage: Bracketed stack and category tags. Uppercase.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code blocks, inline code, and the boot sequence log.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a tag's brackets and text, icon to label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between stacked readouts, tag to tag.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Section index to its rule; corner bracket arm length.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gutter between dashboard panels; page side margin on mobile.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Panel padding; schematic grid pitch.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page side margin on desktop; heading to body in a panel.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between page sections on article pages.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Hero top and bottom padding.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Default for everything: panels, buttons, inputs, tags, images. The HUD is square.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inline code and keyboard keys only.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status dots only.

shadow.note: No elevation shadows. The only shadow is the accent glow, and only in dark.

tokens.name: glow-accent
tokens.usage: Hover on primary button and active status dot in dark theme. The single glow allowed per view.

tokens.name: stroke-hair
tokens.usage: Rules, dividers, schematic grid, input borders.

tokens.name: stroke-bracket
tokens.usage: Corner brackets and the active nav marker.

tokens.name: scanline
tokens.usage: Scanline/grain overlay on bg-000 in dark theme. 0 in light theme and under prefers-reduced-transparency.
